maria (devex): Hey — hitting a weird SSE streaming issue in the wild. When a client reconnects mid-response sometimes we emit duplicate tokens at the end of the new stream.
kevin (eng-runtime): Can you repro? Is this Node-only or seen across SDKs?
maria (devex): Repro on both but behaviour differs. Node client ends up with repeated tail tokens, Python drops the partial and continues cleanly. Repro steps:
  - Start long streaming generation
  - Kill connection (simulated network flake)
  - Trigger auth refresh while reconnecting
  - Reconnect
logs:
```
[stream] last_chunk: "...token-abc"
[reconnect] resume from last_offset: 1024
[stream] first_chunk_after_resume: "token-abc token-def"
```
maria (devex): Looks like the server re-sends the tail and the client reassembles it so we see token-abc twice.
jonathan (eng-ml): That rings a bell — if an in-flight write isn't fully flushed, you can get overlapping bytes. Also auth refresh can cause the runtime to tear the connection and then replay from a safe offset which might overlap one token.
kevin (eng-runtime): Do you have the raw SSE frames? We need to know if it's duplicate `data:` lines or the parser joining half-lines.
maria (devex): raw snippet:
```
data: {"t":"token","id":1000,"text":"...token-abc"}

# disconnect happens here
# reconnect
data: {"t":"token","id":1001,"text":"token-abc token-def"}

```
maria (devex): Python SDK emits id 1000 then 1001 only once; Node SDK emits 1000 then 1000 again then 1001.
kevin (eng-runtime): So Node's SSE parser must be reusing a partial buffer when the connection aborts. Python likely discards incomplete parse state on stream end.
jonathan (eng-ml): Short-term mitigation: include event-level sequence IDs on server and have the SDK dedupe based on (stream_id, event_id). Long-term: make parser reset on disconnect.
maria (devex): Proposed patch for Node SDK:
```
// on 'close' or 'abort'
parser.resetPartialBuffer()
// on reconnect, start fresh
```
maria (devex): Also adding server-side: emit `event-id` and `stream-offset` in SSE JSON so clients can de-dupe deterministically.
kevin (eng-runtime): Agree. I'll open a tiny runtime change to make replay offsets exclusive (avoid re-sending last complete event) and add event_id. Also file an SDK parity ticket: NODE-487 (reset parser on abort) and PY-512 (confirm behavior). @maria can you add a minimal curl + Node repro in the ticket?
maria (devex): Yep will paste curl + Node snippet in the ticket. Quick note: consider auth refresh ordering — if auth refresh triggers a reconnect before the runtime ack, we should prefer graceful drain vs abrupt close.
dev-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/streaming-fixes v0.18.3 -> canary at 02:00 UTC :rocket:
kevin (eng-runtime): Thanks — I'll coordinate canary after the SDK PRs land. :thumbsup:
